feature: Bounded weighted pseudorandom choice among close-scoring actions

policy.fullWidth: 15 percent of the best utility, clamped to 2-10 utility points
policy.weighting: exponential softmax-like weighting with temperature equal to competitive width / 2.25

newCoverage: a close lower score can be selected by a controlled high roll
the best score remains more probable
weak options and other priority layers are excluded
the probability distribution normalizes to one
decision explanations record the completed roll without rerolling
the graph marks weighted candidates and displays their probabilities

installation.reload: Ctrl+F5 sent to the Foundry Virtual Tabletop window after installation
